name: Severe Dementia

global_influences.evidence: Severe Dementia is classified as a Brutal Death Metal band with technical influences and was signed to the international label Demonstealer Records and later Transcending Obscurity Asia, indicating direct engagement with the global extreme-metal label/genre ecosystem rather than domestic mainstream rock influences.
global_influences.source: Wikipedia Severe Dementia (band); Transcending Obscurity Asia signing announcement

local_adaptation_notes: Formed in January 2004 (initially performing as '666' until 2006) by Ahmed Shawki and Saimum Hasan Nahian (who also co-founded Powersurge), Severe Dementia introduced extreme/death metal to a Dhaka scene largely unfamiliar with the genre; the band's thematic focus on ancient and historical events with major national/civilizational impact — reflected in the EP title 'Epitaph of Plassey' (referencing the 1757 Battle of Plassey, a pivotal moment in South Asian colonial history) — grounds extreme metal's global aesthetic in regional historical narrative.
sound_evolution_summary: Founding period (2004–2006): formed as '666,' then renamed Severe Dementia, pioneering death metal within Dhaka's then-unfamiliar extreme metal scene. Breakthrough period (2007): debut EP Epitaph of Plassey, released via Demonstealer Records, is considered the first death metal record in Bangladesh and highly influential within the 'East Bengal Extreme Metal' scene; the band also undertook the first-ever overseas tour by a Bangladeshi underground band (India, April 2007). Hiatus and revival (2012–2016): inactive after vocalist Ahmed Shawki emigrated to Australia; Riasat Azmi took over vocals upon the band's 2016 return, followed by a later signing to Transcending Obscurity Asia.
concert_culture_notes: Made history as the first Bangladeshi underground band to tour overseas (India, 2007), a landmark moment establishing that the country's extreme metal scene could reach international underground audiences well before mainstream Bangladeshi acts achieved comparable international stage presence.
listener_community_notes: A pioneering, foundational node of the 'East Bengal Extreme Metal' scene distinct from and more underground than the mainstream heavy/progressive metal ecosystem (Artcell, Warfaze, Cryptic Fate), with listener appeal concentrated among global extreme-metal subculture audiences via international label distribution.
